name: Barbell hip thrust
cue: Chin tucked, ribs down, squeeze the glutes at the top. Pause 1 sec

name: Hip abduction machine
cue: Lean slightly forward to hit the glutes

name: Hip Adduction Machine
cue: Control the opening, squeeze in fully, pause for a second.

name: Hip thrust
cue: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked, drive the hips up until the shins are vertical and squeeze for a full second.
